analysis_status: designed after the raw 18-period response was reconstructed and sampling-effort concern was raised; bias audit only, not confirmatory ecology
purpose: Resolve the raw-data meaning of sampling effort, quantify effort heterogeneity across the 18 reconstructed subseasons, and test whether apparent gain/loss direction is materially associated with focal-plant observation effort.

census_semantics.missing_obs_time: rows without obs.time are excluded from exact census reconstruction because a 5-min start cannot be uniquely identified
census_semantics.pass_rule: raw unique census counts must exactly reproduce all six published annual totals

subseason_effort_inventory.period_definition: before Nov 1 / Nov 1-30 / after Nov 30 within each declared study year

sampling_completeness.link_surface: 45 plant x 135 pollinator trait subset used by Stage 1
sampling_completeness.role: descriptive detection-completeness diagnostic, not a corrected network estimator

effort_direction_diagnostic.fixed_response_surface: original raw-subseason shared-species dyad rows; eligible dyads are not reselected from effort
effort_direction_diagnostic.score: log(1 + current focal-plant censuses) - log(1 + previous focal-plant censuses)
effort_direction_diagnostic.contrast: among observed changed dyads only, classify gain versus loss from the effort-change score

scopes.strict_dated_core_2008_2010: six within-year transitions; two core sites and no 2011 missing-date boundary
scopes.core_sites_2008_2011: eight transitions; stable two-site pool, includes 2011 date-missingness limitation

effort_only_cv.models: separate gain and loss binomial logistic models
metrics: relative log-loss reduction vs training prevalence

interpretation.allowed: determine whether binary observed-link turnover is materially sampling-effort-sensitive
forbidden: calling effort association pure observer bias because census allocation is partly coupled to flowering availability
calling raw binary gain/loss true rewiring

claim_ceiling: This audit can resolve effort semantics and diagnose whether binary link turnover is detection-sensitive. It cannot separate biological availability from observer allocation or convert observed zeros into true absences. If effort strongly predicts gain/loss, raw 18-period binary changes remain feasibility data rather than ecological rewiring evidence until a detection-standardized response is used.

effort_balanced_rarefaction.role: post-result robustness stress test, not a latent-link estimator
effort_balanced_rarefaction.response_surface: fixed original Stage-1 shared-species dyad rows
effort_balanced_rarefaction.balancing: within each transition x focal plant x site, sample without replacement from both periods to the smaller of the two census counts
report: probability an original gain remains a gain
probability an original loss remains a loss
probability an original stable-present link remains stable-present
transition-level changed-link counts under matched effort
effort_balanced_rarefaction.interpretation: Low state retention means binary link-state classification is sensitive to observation intensity; it does not estimate a false-positive fraction because downsampling can also create non-detections from true persistent links.
